task_language: pick up the book and place it in the front compartment of the caddy

subtasks.name: place(book, caddy_front_compartment, in)
subtasks.outcome: failed: book placed upright in the middle-back compartment (the trained 'back compartment'), not the front one

behaviour_summary: pi0 grasps the book, carries it over the caddy and inserts it in the middle-back cell (127-180), keeps pushing it there until ~300, then probes the middle-front cell with an empty gripper until timeout.
runs_trained_task: STUDY_SCENE1 libero_10: pick up the book and place it in the back compartment of the caddy

failures.mode_definition: Runs the scene's habitual (trained) skill or destination instead of the instructed one.
hl_remedy: HALT when the held book descends toward a caddy cell other than the front one (VERIFY on caddy ROI)
RETREAT up 10 cm keeping the grasp
REPROMPT 'pick up the book and place it in the front compartment of the caddy'
WATCH 5 s; if pi0 again heads for the back cell, ESCALATE (trained-task bias likely to repeat)
failures.prevention: Coordinator flags instructions that differ from a trained libero_10 task only in the destination and arms a destination-ROI VERIFY before release.
failures.observation: 120: book above the back of the caddy; 133-147 lowered into the middle cell behind the divider; 160-260 standing upright there while the gripper adjusts it; ~300 it appears to lie inside the back cell; 340-409 gripper probes the middle-front cell empty.

notes: Black book on black caddy interior is hard to see; final book location (inside middle-back cell) is a visual judgement from evidence_caddy_geometry.png. Which cell LIBERO calls 'front compartment' is assumed to be the middle-front cell.
